title: Reducing attention key size degrades model quality
description: Ablation results show that reducing the attention key dimension d_k hurts model quality, suggesting that dot-product compatibility is not easy and a more sophisticated function may be beneficial.
canonical_description: reducing attention key dimension degrades model quality

evidence.quote: We observe that reducing the attention key size d_k hurts model quality. This suggests that determining compatibility is not easy and that a more sophisticated compatibility function than dot product may be beneficial.
